'''Parakus''' was a small [[Moon/Legends|moon]] in the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]]. The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] kept a garrison there during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Appearances==
*''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]'' {{1stm}}
